title: Recipe for Disaster: Defeating the Culinaromancer
start: Enter the white portal in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.
prereq_quests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Mountain Dwarf
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Goblin Generals
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Pirate Pete
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Lumbridge Sage
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Evil Dave
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Skrach Uglogwee
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing King Awowogei

items.t: Ice gloves for defeating Flambeed, or expect to fight unarmed
Certain armour and weapons for each boss
Good healing food, such as sharks

kills.t: These six culinary bosses must be defeated without prayers or familiars, and some have special mechanics:
Gelatinnoth Mother, level 91 (cannot be damaged with Necromancy)

rewards.t: An antique lamp, which gives 20,000 experience to any skill above 50 (Note: If your backpack is full upon defeating the Culinaromancer, the lamp can be found in your bank. If both your backpack and bank are full, it will be dropped to the floor.)
Full access to the Culinaromancer's Chest

steps.t: It is recommended to bring good food and possibly super potions.
Prayers and Ancient Curses, Summoning familiars, and cannons cannot be used.
Each boss spawns immediately after its predecessor is defeated.
Leaving the boss area and restocking after each boss is allowed.
If killed, your gravestone will appear right outside the Culinaromancer portal.
The Gelatinnoth Mother cannot be damaged with necromancy attack. She can be damaged with poison damage from Putrid Zombie.
Kill the Culinaromancer with any combat style.
